The main street is dotted with quaint old buildings offering a surprising variety of goods and services ranging from fashion to restaurants, curios and antiques. Further along, Caxton Street nightlife abounds with something on offer for all with bars, clubs and live venues.
The rolling and leafy hills of Paddington, Rosalie and nearby Red Hill are speckled with quaint cottages turned enticing shopfronts, restaurants spilling out onto the footpath, traditional tin and timber houses, and renovated Queenslander homes. Visitors will love browsing for quirky keepsakes, vintage and designer fashion, antique and second-hand treasures, retro goods, homewares, and artwork. Rosalie Village is a pocket of streets tucked behind Paddington, featuring a great range of international cuisines and a gourmet market.

Welcome to Coorparoo, a vibrant and historic suburb nestled just 5.7 kilometers southeast of Brisbane's central business district. With a rich history dating back to its Aboriginal origins and its subsequent settlement in the mid-19th century, Coorparoo offers a unique blend of the past and the present, making it an exciting destination for travelers.

Coorparoo's name is thought to derive from an Aboriginal name for Norman Creek and carries a rich Aboriginal heritage. The Coorparoo clan lived south of the Brisbane River, and the area was known for its frequent corroborees, traditional gatherings featuring music and dance, along the banks of Norman Creek. The suburb continued to grow and flourish after white settlement, with early development spurred on by the construction of the bridge at Stanley Street and the extension of the tramway to Buranda in the late 19th century​​.

Ian & Shelley. (Shell).

Coby Lee Beel  |   Apartments on Connor

description:
This Level 4, 1 Bedroom dog-friendly* apartment has everything that you will need to make it your home-away-from-home and your go-to holiday to the city! This self-contained, 56 sqm, private apartment is located within a mostly residential apartment building in Fortitude Valley, just a 5 min walk from the James Street Precinct and right at the heart of Brisbane's Entertainment District.

host_about:
Hello and welcome - I hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you in one of my 11 listings here in Fortitude Valley! 

My name is Coby - I am a licensed real estate agent and the owner of my small, sole trader business Apartments on Connor, which I began in May 2020.  

I take great pride in my business and I hold myself to the highest of standards, through personally cleaning each apartment myself and ensuring the presentation is a welcoming, inviting and special one. It’s important to me to have happy guests that feel appreciated and valued; I want my guests to enjoy their stay and I’m more than happy to go out of my way to provide a great experience. If you’re here for a special occasion I want to know about it!

Our location is a top feature among guests - each listing is situated within the predominantly residential M&A building on Connor Street, within walking distance to everywhere you could hope to visit within this exciting Brisbane suburb. 

We are  just a stone's throw away from the  upmarket James Street Precinct, which offers unforgettable wining and dining experiences within renowned and quaint little cafes, restaurants, and bars; shopping havens of boutique clothing stores and a real relaxed and happy vibe from the locals and travellers that keep Fortitude Valley feeling very different from the fast-paced, city-atmosphere of the Brisbane CBD.

Come and enjoy your holiday within your choice of our select, modern and very comfortable apartments that we offer for stays from 2 nights right up to several months! Unfortunately, we don’t offer permanent leasing.

Car parking for one vehicle is provided free of charge - if you do require another carpark we may be able to arrange this at an extra $25 weekly charge, provided we have the availability to do so. Visitors can make use of the Secure Parking below us, where the rates for visitor parking are displayed at the entrance boom gate.

We offer unlimited and free Wifi (100Mbps typical evening speeds) with a private Netflix account ready to be used!

Our guests are welcome to make use of the Pool and BBQ Recreational deck on Level 3 - please let me know if you would like to use some pool towels! 

If you have a pet that you just can’t leave behind, don’t fret - you may be able to bring your bundle of fluffy joy with you! A select few of our apartments are 'small dog' friendly, providing some requirements are met - please ask me about these requirements if you would like to know more! 

I am very much a ‘dog person’ and believe in giving back to those who need it most. $2 from every guest stay is donated to Bali Animal Welfare Association to help fund the incredible work the BAWA team do, rescuing and protecting the genetically unique Bali Dog and being the saviour to all animals in need, in Bali. I sell not-for-profit jewellery by BAWA’s founder Janice Girardi which 100% of the proceeds go straight to BAWA - get in touch if you would like to see the range while you are here! 

You can reach me on my mobile 24/7 and I am always more than happy to assist our guests where possible to make their stay enjoyable and fondly remembered. I live in the building too, and am never far away should you need my help at all throughout your stay.

I hope to welcome you soon!

Kindest regards,
Coby Lee Beel  |   Apartments on Connor

host_about:
Hello and welcome - I hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you in one of my 11 listings here in Fortitude Valley! 

My name is Coby - I am a licensed real estate agent and the owner of my small, sole trader business Apartments on Connor, which I began in May 2020.  

I take great pride in my business and I hold myself to the highest of standards, through personally cleaning each apartment myself and ensuring the presentation is a welcoming, inviting and special one. It’s important to me to have happy guests that feel appreciated and valued; I want my guests to enjoy their stay and I’m more than happy to go out of my way to provide a great experience. If you’re here for a special occasion I want to know about it!

Our location is a top feature among guests - each listing is situated within the predominantly residential M&A building on Connor Street, within walking distance to everywhere you could hope to visit within this exciting Brisbane suburb. 

We are  just a stone's throw away from the  upmarket James Street Precinct, which offers unforgettable wining and dining experiences within renowned and quaint little cafes, restaurants, and bars; shopping havens of boutique clothing stores and a real relaxed and happy vibe from the locals and travellers that keep Fortitude Valley feeling very different from the fast-paced, city-atmosphere of the Brisbane CBD.

Come and enjoy your holiday within your choice of our select, modern and very comfortable apartments that we offer for stays from 2 nights right up to several months! Unfortunately, we don’t offer permanent leasing.

Car parking for one vehicle is provided free of charge - if you do require another carpark we may be able to arrange this at an extra $25 weekly charge, provided we have the availability to do so. Visitors can make use of the Secure Parking below us, where the rates for visitor parking are displayed at the entrance boom gate.

We offer unlimited and free Wifi (100Mbps typical evening speeds) with a private Netflix account ready to be used!

Our guests are welcome to make use of the Pool and BBQ Recreational deck on Level 3 - please let me know if you would like to use some pool towels! 

If you have a pet that you just can’t leave behind, don’t fret - you may be able to bring your bundle of fluffy joy with you! A select few of our apartments are 'small dog' friendly, providing some requirements are met - please ask me about these requirements if you would like to know more! 

I am very much a ‘dog person’ and believe in giving back to those who need it most. $2 from every guest stay is donated to Bali Animal Welfare Association to help fund the incredible work the BAWA team do, rescuing and protecting the genetically unique Bali Dog and being the saviour to all animals in need, in Bali. I sell not-for-profit jewellery by BAWA’s founder Janice Girardi which 100% of the proceeds go straight to BAWA - get in touch if you would like to see the range while you are here! 

You can reach me on my mobile 24/7 and I am always more than happy to assist our guests where possible to make their stay enjoyable and fondly remembered. I live in the building too, and am never far away should you need my help at all throughout your stay.

I hope to welcome you soon!

Kindest regards,
Coby Lee Beel  |   Apartments on Connor

Coby Lee Beel  |   Apartments on Connor

host_about:
Hello and welcome - I hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you in one of my 11 listings here in Fortitude Valley! 

My name is Coby - I am a licensed real estate agent and the owner of my small, sole trader business Apartments on Connor, which I began in May 2020.  

I take great pride in my business and I hold myself to the highest of standards, through personally cleaning each apartment myself and ensuring the presentation is a welcoming, inviting and special one. It’s important to me to have happy guests that feel appreciated and valued; I want my guests to enjoy their stay and I’m more than happy to go out of my way to provide a great experience. If you’re here for a special occasion I want to know about it!

Our location is a top feature among guests - each listing is situated within the predominantly residential M&A building on Connor Street, within walking distance to everywhere you could hope to visit within this exciting Brisbane suburb. 

We are  just a stone's throw away from the  upmarket James Street Precinct, which offers unforgettable wining and dining experiences within renowned and quaint little cafes, restaurants, and bars; shopping havens of boutique clothing stores and a real relaxed and happy vibe from the locals and travellers that keep Fortitude Valley feeling very different from the fast-paced, city-atmosphere of the Brisbane CBD.

Come and enjoy your holiday within your choice of our select, modern and very comfortable apartments that we offer for stays from 2 nights right up to several months! Unfortunately, we don’t offer permanent leasing.

Car parking for one vehicle is provided free of charge - if you do require another carpark we may be able to arrange this at an extra $25 weekly charge, provided we have the availability to do so. Visitors can make use of the Secure Parking below us, where the rates for visitor parking are displayed at the entrance boom gate.

We offer unlimited and free Wifi (100Mbps typical evening speeds) with a private Netflix account ready to be used!

Our guests are welcome to make use of the Pool and BBQ Recreational deck on Level 3 - please let me know if you would like to use some pool towels! 

If you have a pet that you just can’t leave behind, don’t fret - you may be able to bring your bundle of fluffy joy with you! A select few of our apartments are 'small dog' friendly, providing some requirements are met - please ask me about these requirements if you would like to know more! 

I am very much a ‘dog person’ and believe in giving back to those who need it most. $2 from every guest stay is donated to Bali Animal Welfare Association to help fund the incredible work the BAWA team do, rescuing and protecting the genetically unique Bali Dog and being the saviour to all animals in need, in Bali. I sell not-for-profit jewellery by BAWA’s founder Janice Girardi which 100% of the proceeds go straight to BAWA - get in touch if you would like to see the range while you are here! 

You can reach me on my mobile 24/7 and I am always more than happy to assist our guests where possible to make their stay enjoyable and fondly remembered. I live in the building too, and am never far away should you need my help at all throughout your stay.

I hope to welcome you soon!

Kindest regards,
Coby Lee Beel  |   Apartments on Connor

Some of my favourite destinations are Russia and in particular Moscow, Ireland, Canada in particular Whistler, New York, and Mongolia. I have also travelled up the West Coast of the States (including Hawaii & Mexico), Germany, Netherlands, United Kingdom, France, Italy, Spain, Poland, Czech Republic, Austria, Slovakia, Hungary, India, China, South Korea, Japan, Fiji, New Zealand, Singapore, Indonesia, Vanuatu, Malaysia and around Australia. I'm looking forward to seeing a lot more of the world.

Our newly furnished 2 - bedroom 2 - bathroom apartment is at the heart of fortitude valley - the entertainment precinct in Brisbane! Fortitude Valley train station is right downstairs and it will be the perfect base for your adventure in Brisbane!

♥ Level 11 with Great City Views

♥ Rooftop pool & BBQ

♥ Valley Central Location:
500m walking distance to Chinatown, shopping centre + best bars & clubs in BNE!
5 min drive to Brisbane CBD area

♥ Luxury resident amenities - pool, sauna,
neighborhood_overview:
From unique laneways, to The Wickham Street Mall and Chinatown, the Valley is home to hundreds of trendy cafes, the city's best bars and super clubs, as well as restaurants, boutiques and cultural hotspots that celebrate Brisbane's diversity.

Best of all, the Valley is at the axis of Brisbane's fastest developing activity zone, with adjacent suburbs of New Farm, Newstead, Teneriffe and Bowen Hills providing a dizzying array of places to meet, eat and relax. From the tree-lined boutique boulevard of James Street, with its fresh food markets, Cru Bar and Spoon, to the new, multi-million dollar Gasworks developments, Hatch & Co and Max Brenner, there are myraid of ways to while away lazy Sunday mornings or linger over a long lunch.
host_about:
Ever since I was little, I always dreamt about travelling to new places for my own little adventures. I have backpacked throughout Southeast Asia, Europe and parts of South America. I have stayed in all sorts of accommodations from luxury hotels to a couch in someone's living room. Some of my experiences were absolutely magical while some could be horrifying. 

Inspired by my own travelling experiences, I have moved back to Australia and started hosting myself at the very beginning of 2020 during covid times. Some friends started to ask me to help them with hosting while they were abroad and little by little I have started my own small business helping like-minded people to put their homes on Airbnb! 

We wish to provide all our guests unique experiences with all our beautiful homes and make their travel unforgettable!

name: Go solo! Airport. Safe, peace & quiet.
description:
Eco-friendly room with no air-conditioning, natural afternoon seabreeze only. Peaceful and serene home, conveniently located just a short drive from Brisbane Airport. Minimalist, cozy and safe home is situated amidst lush greenery, providing the ideal setting for bird watching, outdoor exercise, walks, and bike rides.

We have poodle in the house.

Short trip to your local hot bread, IGA, café, popular eateries like Guzman, Noddle Box, Zarraffa's and many others.

We look forward to hosting you!
neighborhood_overview:
Peaceful and quiet, yet close to everything. It has a very suburban feel, you must like nature, birds, green, plants, smell of cut grass, people smiling and saying "hi".

There's dogs walking people, the fit running and cycling tracks, and children climbing local playground and trees. This is before the rays of the sun ever so gently graces us through the green fields in the silent morning.

You will be woken to the call of birds up for the morning worms, invited to feel the Queensland heat and your sweat beads, yet at night hushed to sleep by the delicious evening sea breeze.

To me, it's called Eden.
host_about:

Welcome to Coorparoo, a vibrant and historic suburb nestled just 5.7 kilometers southeast of Brisbane's central business district. With a rich history dating back to its Aboriginal origins and its subsequent settlement in the mid-19th century, Coorparoo offers a unique blend of the past and the present, making it an exciting destination for travelers.

Coorparoo's name is thought to derive from an Aboriginal name for Norman Creek and carries a rich Aboriginal heritage. The Coorparoo clan lived south of the Brisbane River, and the area was known for its frequent corroborees, traditional gatherings featuring music and dance, along the banks of Norman Creek. The suburb continued to grow and flourish after white settlement, with early development spurred on by the construction of the bridge at Stanley Street and the extension of the tramway to Buranda in the late 19th century​​.

host_about:
Ever since I was little, I always dreamt about travelling to new places for my own little adventures. I have backpacked throughout Southeast Asia, Europe and parts of South America. I have stayed in all sorts of accommodations from luxury hotels to a couch in someone's living room. Some of my experiences were absolutely magical while some could be horrifying. 

Inspired by my own travelling experiences, I have moved back to Australia and started hosting myself at the very beginning of 2020 during covid times. neighborhood_overview:
Welcome to Coorparoo, a vibrant and historic suburb nestled just 5.7 kilometers southeast of Brisbane's central business district. With a rich history dating back to its Aboriginal origins and its subsequent settlement in the mid-19th century, Coorparoo offers a unique blend of the past and the present, making it an exciting destination for travelers.

Coorparoo's name is thought to derive from an Aboriginal name for Norman Creek and carries a rich Aboriginal heritage. The Coorparoo clan lived south of the Brisbane River, and the area was known for its frequent corroborees, traditional gatherings featuring music and dance, along the banks of Norman Creek. The suburb continued to grow and flourish after white settlement, with early development spurred on by the construction of the bridge at Stanley Street and the extension of the tramway to Buranda in the late 19th century​​.

neighborhood_overview:
Welcome to Coorparoo, a vibrant and historic suburb nestled just 5.7 kilometers southeast of Brisbane's central business district. With a rich history dating back to its Aboriginal origins and its subsequent settlement in the mid-19th century, Coorparoo offers a unique blend of the past and the present, making it an exciting destination for travelers.

Coorparoo's name is thought to derive from an Aboriginal name for Norman Creek and carries a rich Aboriginal heritage. The Coorparoo clan lived south of the Brisbane River, and the area was known for its frequent corroborees, traditional gatherings featuring music and dance, along the banks of Norman Creek. The suburb continued to grow and flourish after white settlement, with early development spurred on by the construction of the bridge at Stanley Street and the extension of the tramway to Buranda in the late 19th century​​.

Hello and welcome - I hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you in one of my 11 listings here in Fortitude Valley! 

My name is Coby - I am a licensed real estate agent and the owner of my small, sole trader business Apartments on Connor, which I began in May 2020.  

I take great pride in my business and I hold myself to the highest of standards, through personally cleaning each apartment myself and ensuring the presentation is a welcoming, inviting and special one. It’s important to me to have happy guests that feel appreciated and valued; I want my guests to enjoy their stay and I’m more than happy to go out of my way to provide a great experience. If you’re here for a special occasion I want to know about it!

Our location is a top feature among guests - each listing is situated within the predominantly residential M&A building on Connor Street, within walking distance to everywhere you could hope to visit within this exciting Brisbane suburb. 

We are  just a stone's throw away from the  upmarket James Street Precinct, which offers unforgettable wining and dining experiences within renowned and quaint little cafes, restaurants, and bars; shopping havens of boutique clothing stores and a real relaxed and happy vibe from the locals and travellers that keep Fortitude Valley feeling very different from the fast-paced, city-atmosphere of the Brisbane CBD.

Come and enjoy your holiday within your choice of our select, modern and very comfortable apartments that we offer for stays from 2 nights right up to several months! Unfortunately, we don’t offer permanent leasing.

Car parking for one vehicle is provided free of charge - if you do require another carpark we may be able to arrange this at an extra $25 weekly charge, provided we have the availability to do so. Visitors can make use of the Secure Parking below us, where the rates for visitor parking are displayed at the entrance boom gate.

We offer unlimited and free Wifi (100Mbps typical evening speeds) with a private Netflix account ready to be used!

Our guests are welcome to make use of the Pool and BBQ Recreational deck on Level 3 - please let me know if you would like to use some pool towels! 

If you have a pet that you just can’t leave behind, don’t fret - you may be able to bring your bundle of fluffy joy with you! A select few of our apartments are 'small dog' friendly, providing some requirements are met - please ask me about these requirements if you would like to know more! 

I am very much a ‘dog person’ and believe in giving back to those who need it most. $2 from every guest stay is donated to Bali Animal Welfare Association to help fund the incredible work the BAWA team do, rescuing and protecting the genetically unique Bali Dog and being the saviour to all animals in need, in Bali. I sell not-for-profit jewellery by BAWA’s founder Janice Girardi which 100% of the proceeds go straight to BAWA - get in touch if you would like to see the range while you are here! 

You can reach me on my mobile 24/7 and I am always more than happy to assist our guests where possible to make their stay enjoyable and fondly remembered. I live in the building too, and am never far away should you need my help at all throughout your stay.

I hope to welcome you soon!

Kindest regards,
Coby Lee Beel  |   Apartments on Connor

host_about:
Ever since I was little, I always dreamt about travelling to new places for my own little adventures. I have backpacked throughout Southeast Asia, Europe and parts of South America. I have stayed in all sorts of accommodations from luxury hotels to a couch in someone's living room. Some of my experiences were absolutely magical while some could be horrifying. 

Inspired by my own travelling experiences, I have moved back to Australia and started hosting myself at the very beginning of 2020 during covid times. host_about:
Ever since I was little, I always dreamt about travelling to new places for my own little adventures. I have backpacked throughout Southeast Asia, Europe and parts of South America. I have stayed in all sorts of accommodations from luxury hotels to a couch in someone's living room. Some of my experiences were absolutely magical while some could be horrifying. 

Inspired by my own travelling experiences, I have moved back to Australia and started hosting myself at the very beginning of 2020 during covid times. neighborhood_overview: Fortitude Valley, commonly known as "The Valley," is a vibrant inner-city suburb of Brisbane. Steeped in history, it was named after the ship "Fortitude" that transported convicts in the 1820s. Today, it stands as a cultural hub with a thriving arts, music, and nightlife scene, hosting a plethora of live music venues, art galleries, and theatres. The area is renowned for its diverse shopping experiences, ranging from boutique stores to high-end fashion boutiques, with popular precincts like the Emporium and James Street. Fortitude Valley also offers a wide array of dining options, showcasing global cuisines and trendy restaurants. Connected by a railway station and several bus routes, it remains an accessible locale. With an energetic nightlife, the area hosts events and festivals. Fortitude Valley is an ever-evolving, cosmopolitan destination that caters to diverse interests and lifestyles.

neighborhood_overview: Fortitude Valley, commonly known as "The Valley," is a vibrant inner-city suburb of Brisbane. Today, it stands as a cultural hub with a thriving arts, music, and nightlife scene, hosting a plethora of live music venues, art galleries, and theatres. The area is renowned for its diverse shopping experiences, ranging from boutique stores to high-end fashion boutiques, with popular precincts like the Emporium and James Street. Fortitude Valley also offers a wide array of dining options, showcasing global cuisines and trendy restaurants. Connected by a railway station and several bus routes, it remains an accessible locale. With an energetic nightlife, the area hosts events and festivals. Fortitude Valley is an ever-evolving, cosmopolitan destination that caters to diverse interests and lifestyles.

Today, it stands as a cultural hub with a thriving arts, music, and nightlife scene, hosting an abundance of live music venues, art galleries, and theatres.

The area is well known for its diverse shopping experiences, ranging from boutique stores to high-end fashion boutiques, with popular precincts like the Emporium and James Street. Fortitude Valley also offers a wide array of dining options, showcasing global cuisines and trendy restaurants.

Connected by a railway station and several bus routes, it remains an accessible locale. With an energetic nightlife, the area hosts events and festivals. Fortitude Valley is an ever-evolving, cosmopolitan destination that caters to diverse interests and lifestyles.
